Pinterest is expanding its parental control infrastructure to allow guardians to limit the volume of synthetic, AI-generated media displayed within teenage user feeds. The update distinguishes the visual discovery platform from competitors like Meta and Snap, which have primarily restricted minor access to conversational chatbots and standalone AI generation tools rather than algorithmic feed curation.
